caption:
Your website form fills out. The lead lands in your inbox. You see it at 9pm, hours too late.

Fix it with two short texts, sent fast.

Text 1, within 5 minutes: confirm you got it, ask one easy question.

"Thanks for reaching out about [service]. Mornings or afternoons work better this week?"

Text 2, if no reply in 10 minutes: give two exact times instead of asking again.

"No rush, I have 2pm today or 10am tomorrow, whichever's easier."

One question per text. Never "let me know what works for you." That's homework, and a lead who just filled out a form won't do it.

Most service businesses check new leads once a day, usually after close. Answer in minutes and you're ahead of almost everyone still checking email that night.
